request.subject: field
request.description: Style: flat-shaded cartoon game terrain, flat colour fills with no gradients, two or three greens only, low detail, simple graphic shapes. Subject: a wide flat meadow of short lawn grass seen from directly above, one even fresh green base colour with small darker grass tufts scattered evenly and sparsely all over, the same everywhere, nothing else. Straight top-down view of flat ground filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no perspective, no horizon, no lighting gradient. Must not include: border, frame, hedge, bushes, vignette, dark corners, light spot, lighting gradient, path, road, water, rocks, stones, flowers, trees, buildings, characters, people, text, perspective, horizon, red; gradients, dithering, texture, high detail.
